3.text: Indeed, We sent it down during a blessed night.<sup foot_note="227817">1</sup> Indeed, We were to warn [mankind].

footnotes.227817: - The Night of Decree (Qadr). See Sūrah al-Qadr.

4.text: Therein [i.e., on that night] is made distinct<sup foot_note="227818">1</sup> every precise matter -

footnotes.227818: - Or "is separated" or "apportioned," from what is inscribed in the Preserved Slate.  The angels record and descend with whatever Allāh has decreed for the coming year.

5.text: [Every] matter [proceeding] from Us. Indeed, We were to send [a messenger]

6.text: As mercy from your Lord. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing,

7.text: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them, if you would be certain.

8.text: There is no deity except Him; He gives life and causes death. [He is] your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers.

9.text: But they are in doubt, amusing themselves.

10.text: Then watch for the Day when the sky will bring a visible smoke

11.text: Covering the people; this is a painful torment.

12.text: [They will say], "Our Lord, remove from us the torment; indeed, we are believers."

13.text: How will there be for them a reminder [at that time]? And there had come to them a clear Messenger.

14.text: Then they turned away from him and said, "[He was] taught [and is] a madman."

15.text: Indeed, We will remove the torment for a little. Indeed, you [disbelievers] will return [to disbelief].

16.text: The Day We will strike with the greatest assault, indeed, We will take retribution.

17.text: And We had already tried before them the people of Pharaoh, and there came to them a noble messenger [i.e., Moses],

18.text: [Saying], "Render to me the servants of Allāh.<sup foot_note="227819">1</sup> Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger,"

19.text: And [saying], "Be not haughty with Allāh. Indeed, I have come to you with clear evidence.

20.text: And indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me.<sup foot_note="227820">1</sup>

footnotes.227820: - To death.  Or "lest you assault me [with your tongues or harm me otherwise]."

21.text: But if you do not believe me, then leave me alone."

22.text: And [finally] he called to his Lord that these were a criminal people.

23.text: [Allāh said], "Then set out with My servants by night. Indeed, you are to be pursued.

24.text: And leave the sea in stillness.<sup foot_note="227821">1</sup> Indeed, they are an army to be drowned."

footnotes.227821: - After it has parted, in order that the soldiers of Pharaoh would follow the Children of Israel and be drowned.

25.text: How much they left behind of gardens and springs

27.text: And comfort wherein they were amused.

28.text: Thus. And We caused to inherit it another people.

29.text: And the heaven and earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.

30.text: And We certainly saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment -

31.text: From Pharaoh. Indeed, he was a haughty one among the transgressors.

32.text: And We certainly chose them by knowledge over [all] the worlds.

33.text: And We gave them of signs that in which there was a clear trial.

35.text: "There is not but our first death, and we will not be resurrected.

36.text: Then bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."

37.text: Are they better or the people of Tubbaʿ<sup foot_note="227822">1</sup> and those before them? We destroyed them, [for] indeed, they were criminals.

38.text: And We did not create the heavens and earth and that between them in play.

39.text: We did not create them except in truth, but most of them do not know.

40.text: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is the appointed time for them all -

41.text: The Day when no relation<sup foot_note="227823">1</sup> will avail a relation at all, nor will they be helped -

footnotes.227823: - i.e., patron, protector or close associate.

42.text: Except those [believers] on whom Allāh has mercy. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

45.text: Like murky oil, it boils within bellies

46.text: Like the boiling of scalding water.

47.text: [It will be commanded], "Seize him and drag him into the midst of the Hellfire,

48.text: Then pour over his head from the torment of scalding water."

49.text: [It will be said], "Taste! Indeed, you are the honored, the noble!<sup foot_note="227824">1</sup>

footnotes.227824: - As he had claimed upon the earth.  He is taunted with these words in Hell as a reminder and additional torment.

50.text: Indeed, this is what you used to dispute."

51.text: Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place:

53.text: Wearing [garments of] fine silk and brocade, facing each other.

54.text: Thus. And We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.

55.text: They will call therein for every [kind of] fruit - safe and secure.

56.text: They will not taste death therein except the first death, and He will have protected them from the punishment of Hellfire

57.text: As bounty from your Lord. That is what is the great attainment.

58.text: And indeed, We have eased it [i.e., the Qur’ān] in your tongue that they might be reminded.

59.text: So watch, [O Muḥammad]; indeed, they are watching [for your end].
